description: Adafruit ESP32 Feather V2 (PID 5400): ESP32-D0WD-V3 with 8 MB flash and 2 MB PSRAM, STEMMA QT I2C. Runs via the arduino-esp32 snapshot profile.
catalog_notes: Serial output is not captured on the classic ESP32 profile; the onboarding smoke asserts GPIO state instead.
GPIO2 powers both STEMMA QT and the NeoPixel and defaults low.
